mapper.insert: INSERT INTO posts (user_id, title, content, board_id, image_url) VALUES (#{userId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{boardType}, #{imageUrl})
mapper.select: SELECT post_id, board_id, created_at, updated_at, view_count, title, content, image_url, like_count FROM posts WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND is_delete = false
mapper.update: UPDATE posts SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, image_url = #{imageUrl}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE post_id = #{postId}
mapper.select: SELECT p.post_id, p.board_id, p.user_id, p.created_at, p.updated_at, p.view_count, p.title, p.content, p.image_url, p.like_count, p.is_delete, u.nick_name FROM posts p JOIN users u ON p.user_id = u.user_id WHERE p.user_id = #{userId} and p.is_delete = false
